first.rationale: The two measured declines this quarter are onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%), so the highest-leverage single slot is the one that attacks the funnel stage that actually regressed rather than the one that answers the competitor's press release. memory_86 (shorter onboarding lifts completion and time-to-value) and memory_31 (fewer signup fields lifts first-week activation) are the two memories directly load-bearing for that choice, so those are the two I spend verification budget on. I specifically want the original records to check whether the reported lifts were measured on activation/completion alone or were ever carried through to qualified revenue and retention, and whether the signup-field cut degraded lead quality ecording only the top-of-funnel win. Consolidated summaries tend to lose exactly those caveats, and the phrase 'durable lift in first-week activation' in memory_31 is the kind of claim that survives consolidation even when the revenue follow-through did not. I am deliberately not choosing promotional_pricing (memory_73) despite the competitor pressure: discount-led acquisition into a price-sensitive SMB segment is the classic path to volume that does not become sustainable qualified revenue, it resets price expectations for the existing base, and it does nothing for the two metrics that actually moved. Referral (memory_57) and enterprise sales-assist (memory_44) are plausible but address segments that are not currently regressing. Activation messaging (memory_91) is the strong second choice and is the natural follow-up if verification undercuts the onboarding records. Running at standard_experiment scale rather than broad rollout because the inherited evidence is archived summary, not re-observed on current traffic, and the competitor's move may have shifted the incoming mix enough that day-12 and day-52 results no longer transfer. Guardrails: hold out a control, and instrument downstream qualified-revenue and 90-day retention per cohort, not just completion rate, so we do not buy an activation number with worse-quality accounts. If verification shows the lifts were never tied to revenue, I drop to a small guarded test.
